entities.name: Shilgengar's Ritual
entities.description: Event on Innistrad c. -2421 AR that was the origin of vampires.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: Demon who caused a great famine and manipulated Edgar Markov into blood magic.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Aging human alchemist who turned to blood magic and led the ritual.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: Edgar's only grandson, forced to turn; the trauma ignited his planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Marycz
entities.description: Angel trapped and exsanguinated by Edgar and his sons.

events.summary: Shilgengar causes a great famine in the lands of what would become Stensia.
events.quote: the demon Shilgengar caused a great famine in the lands of what would become Stensia

events.summary: Shilgengar convinces Edgar Markov to turn to blood experiments.
events.quote: the demon managed to convince Edgar to start his experiments with blood

events.summary: Edgar and his sons trap the angel Marycz, exsanguinate her and create the ritual from a decoction of her blood.
events.quote: Edgar and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her

events.summary: Edgar forces Sorin to turn; the trauma ignites Sorin's planeswalker spark and he leaves the plane.
events.quote: the trauma of the transformation caused Sorin's planeswalker spark to ignite

relations.quote: Edgar and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her
then manipulated the aging human alchemist Edgar Markov into turning to blood magic
